sentences.text: This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.220/2023 registered at Police Station Uday Nagar, District Dewas (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 376A, 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 5L, 6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 16/07/2023.

2. After arguing for some time, learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the present bail application with liberty to renew his prayer after examination of the prosecutrix before the trial Court.
